mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_post (board_id, author_id, title, content, view_count, like_count, comment_count, is_top, status) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.board_id, p.author_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_top, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM forum_post p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1

UPDATE forum_post
board_id = #{boardId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_post SET status = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE forum_post SET is_top = #{isTop}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_post SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post WHERE status = 1

SELECT p.post_id, p.board_id, p.author_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.is_top, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM forum_post p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.like_count DESC, p.comment_count DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
